description: Create the service layer foundation in src/services/ - async StorageService, HotkeyService, and SessionService that run in the main process (CommonJS). These provide cleaner abstractions over the raw storage.js and window.js code.
steps: Create src/services/StorageService.js - CommonJS module. Class with: constructor() initializes in-memory cache (empty objects). async init() loads all data from storage.js into cache using require('../storage'). get(key) returns value from cache. set(key, value) updates cache immediately and schedules a debounced flush (200ms timeout). getAll() returns full cache copy. flush() writes pending changes immediately to disk using storage.js functions. Uses existing storage.js internally: getPreferences(), getConfig(), getWindowState(), getKeybinds(), getTypingSettings(), and the corresponding setters. The cache is organized as { preferences: {...}, config: {...}, windowState: {...}, keybinds: {...}, typingSettings: {...} }.

Create src/services/HotkeyService.js - CommonJS module. Class with: constructor() creates a _registry Map. register(action, accelerator, handler) - uses Electron globalShortcut.register(), stores {accelerator, handler} in the Map keyed by action. unregister(action) - looks up action in Map, calls globalShortcut.unregister(accelerator), removes from Map. updateBinding(action, newAccelerator, handler) - if action exists with same accelerator, skip. Otherwise unregister old, register new. rebuildAll(keybinds, handlers) - full rebuild fallback: unregisters everything, re-registers from keybinds object. getRegistered() - returns Object.fromEntries of the Map. Does NOT call globalShortcut.unregisterAll() on every change - only changes what is different.

Create src/services/SessionService.js - CommonJS module. Class extends require('events').EventEmitter. Holds _session reference (the live session object), _active boolean, _provider string, _profile string, _startTime timestamp, _connected boolean. Methods: start(params) - stores params, sets _active=true, emits 'started'. stop() - sets _active=false, clears _session, emits 'stopped'. isActive() returns _active. getStatus() returns { active, provider, profile, duration: Date.now() - _startTime, connected }. setSession(sessionObj) - stores reference. getSession() - returns reference. Events: 'started', 'stopped', 'reconnecting', 'error'. Route-independent.
Create src/services/index.js - CommonJS barrel export: module.exports = { StorageService, HotkeyService, SessionService }.
acceptance_criteria: src/services/StorageService.js exports a class with get(key), set(key, value), getAll(), flush() methods, uses 200ms debounced writes

src/services/HotkeyService.js exports a class with register(action, accelerator, handler), unregister(action), updateBinding(action, newAccelerator, handler), rebuildAll(keybinds, handlers), getRegistered()
src/services/SessionService.js exports an EventEmitter class with start(params), stop(), isActive(), getStatus() and session reference management
All service files use CommonJS (require/module.exports) since they run in main process
Services reference existing storage.js and Electron APIs internally but do not break if Electron is not available (graceful checks)
verification: Run: node -e "require('./src/services')" to confirm all services load without error
